subject: Civil Engineering
title: Types of Tunnels
description: A quick win: understand Types of Tunnels.

hook.text: Not all tunnels are the same — each serves a different purpose with different demands.

buildup.text: Transportation tunnels carry vehicles or trains. They need ventilation and wide cross-sections.

discovery.text: Water tunnels convey drinking water or sewage — pressurized, deep, and often miles long.

twist.text: Utility tunnels house cables, pipes, and gas lines — London's Victorian utility tunnels still serve today.

climax.text: Mining tunnels extract ore — temporary structures compared to permanent civil tunnels.

punchline.text: Every tunnel is designed for its cargo — people, water, power, or rock.

quiz.question: What makes transportation tunnels different from water tunnels?
options: Transportation tunnels need ventilation and wider cross-sections for vehicles
Water tunnels are always shorter than transportation tunnels
Transportation tunnels are always built deeper underground
